title: Korg MS-20 Original Owner's Manual
summary: Korg's original owner's manual for the MS-20: the signal flow of the patch panel, how the highpass and lowpass filters, peak (resonance) and cutoff controls behave, and the external signal processor. The user-level reference for how the circuits are meant to be played.
